text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a lightweight partner SEV flow for three integrations next quarter: CloudX marketplace listing, TitanHW drivers, and BrightSI managed deploys. Can we align on channel usage, initial triage owner, and oncall routing?

alex: +1. My proposal: one ephemeral shared channel per partner for urgent work, plus a central #partner-sev for signals/rotations. Keeps partner context isolated but lets SRE/Eng subscribe to the single stream.

maria: I like isolated channels. For marketplace issues (CloudX) we also need to loop in the marketplace support contact and our marketplace PM.

tony: For HW (TitanHW) there are often firmware vs infra vs drivers triage splits. Suggest we pre-author an "owner matrix" doc and reference it in the channel topic. Example: driver -> eng-runtime, firmware -> partner-liaison (eline), field ops -> oncall-hw.

maria: aggree. Can we include an initial escalation step: 1) partner DRI posts in partner channel, 2) our oncall triages within 15m, 3) if not resolved in 60m escalate to cross-org war room/bridge?

eline: Sounds good. For SI (BrightSI) they expect a named TAM on our side. We should include a direct mention list in the channel topic: @tams, @platform-oncall, @partnerships.

alex: Operational detail: use ChatOps snippets to create the bridge and capture artifacts. e.g. `/incident create --title "Partner SEV: <partner>" --tags partner,marketplace` then bot posts join link. Keeps audits consistent.

ops-bot: Created warroom 1916001280: https://redwood.internal/warroom/1916001280 — participants: @maria, @alex, @tony, @eline. Use `ops-bot collect-logs` to pull runtime traces.

maria: Good — can someone add the runbook checklist to the partner channel topic? Minimal checklist: contact list, escalation ladder, expected SLA/ETA, evidence bucket (logs/screenshots), and postmortem owner.

tony: I'll draft the owner matrix and checklist. Planning to post PR to the partnerships repo today.

eline: I'll coordinate TAM assignments with BrightSI and share the contact card.

alex: One more ask — can we agree on a fallback model when oncall can't reach partner (eg. weekend)? Suggest: escalate to Partner Ops pager then to Partnerships lead on call.

maria: agreed. Let's capture that as step 2b in the checklist. I'll assemble a short one-pager and share in #partnerships before EOD. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — once we have the one-pager we can wire up channel templates + ChatOps shortcuts so creates are < 1 min.

maria: perfect. tagging follow-ups: @tony (owner matrix PR), @eline (TAM contact), @alex (chatops template). We'll reconvene after PR merge.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled DR drill with TitanHW next Tues 09:00 PT. Bridge will be auto-created.

maria: noted — adding drill to partner calendar. Thanks everyone.
